author: gahajagahba
title: Staff not supportive
review_text: I just wanted to add my gmail account in eSewa account to receive OTP and staff named Suman Shrestha is asking me so many documents to add gmail account from his side. I provided all of those details and documents then after that again he is asking me Esewa remit receipt which I have never used as I am abroad since long time which I explained him already. Instead of making it complicated for users, please make it easy, convenient and try to be supportive.
